menu.howBody:
Need a place? Book with us is a student housing marketplace for Palestine.

Students: sign up with a university email (.edu or .edu.ps), search near your campus, save listings, book, and chat with the owner.

Looking to rent: workers, families, and anyone else can create a renter account with any email, then search, book, and message owners.

Apartment owners: accounts are created by the admin only. After approval you can add listings and manage bookings.

Payments in this version are simulated. Pay now / pay later do not charge a real card.
menu.privacyBody:
This policy explains how Need a place? Book with us uses your data.

We collect what we need to run the marketplace: name, email, phone, city, university, profile photo, listing details, bookings, chat messages, and an optional push-notification token.

Data is stored on our servers (Supabase). We do not sell your data. This version does not process real card payments.

We use the data to operate your account, show relevant housing, handle bookings, provide support, and improve the app.

To ask for account deletion or a privacy question, email {{email}}.

Last updated: August 2026.
menu.termsBody:
By using the app you agree to these terms.

The app is a marketplace that connects people looking for housing with apartment owners in Palestine, with students as the main audience. A booking in the app is a request to the owner; it is not by itself a legal lease.

Students must use a valid university email. Renters (workers, families, and others) may use any valid email. Owner accounts are created by the admin. Listings must be truthful. We may hide or remove listings that break the rules.

Payments are simulated in this version. No real card is charged.

Use the app in good faith. Do not harass other users. Contact {{email}} for support or to close your account.

Last updated: August 2026.
